subject: FortressBank SIG: KMS / BYOK packaging and ingest plan
messages:
From: Jill Park <jill.park@fortressbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Mar 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: SIG request: KMS/BYOK specifics and artifact delivery

Hi Tessa,

Following our vendor security review kickoff, the FortressBank security team has a few focused asks around key management before we can complete our SIG evaluation: 

- Confirmation of BYOK capabilities across Hosted/Dedicated/Private modes (can customers import keys / hold private key material?).
- Recent key-rotation evidence (last 12 months) and a short description of rotation process and automation
- HSM vendor(s) and where HSM attestation (if any) is stored
- A control map showing which SIG controls are satisfied by KMS/HSM features (high level is fine), plus any exclusions

Can you share a proposed delivery plan and a secure location we can pull the artifacts from? We are aiming to close this section by 3/14.

Thanks,
Jill Park
Senior Information Security Manager
FortressBank

--
Attachment: (none in initial request)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jill Park <jill.park@fortressbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Mar 2025 11:12:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SIG request: KMS/BYOK specifics and artifact delivery

Hi Jill — thanks for the clear asks. We're happy to provide the artifacts and a short control mapping. Proposed plan below.

Planned deliverables (candidate files):
- BYOK-capabilities.md (explain per-deployment behavior and limitations)
- sig-kms-control-mapping.xlsx (control -> artifact mapping)
- kms-rotation-report-202412.csv (rotation events summary, redacted UIDs)
- hsm-architecture-diagram.pdf (deployment sketch + vendor names)

Timeline (goal: meet your 3/14 target):
- 3/07: Internal package assembled and initial upload to secure share
- 3/09: Follow-up call to walk through mapping (30 min) — tentative slot 3/09 10:00 PT
- 3/11: Finalized package (post Q&A) uploaded to DocuSign/secure link for your team

Questions / clarifications for our collectors:
1) Do you need raw rotation logs or a summarized CSV (we recommend summary + sample rows for privacy)?
2) Any particular SIG sections you want prioritized in the mapping (e.g., CRYPTO, KEY MGMT, CRYPTOPERMS)?

Aditya and Monica, please coordinate: Aditya — lead on rotation artifacts and BYOK policy text. Monica — pull HSM attestations and create the mapping spreadsheet.

Jill — I put a temporary secure share link below; we'll move final artifacts to your DocuSign bundle once we complete the walk-through. If the 3/09 slot doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Secure share (temp): https://redwood-secure-shared.example.com/FB/pack-7423

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Solutions — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs referenced: sig-kms-control-mapping.xlsx (planned), kms-rotation-report-202412.csv (planned), hsm-architecture-diagram.pdf (planned)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jill Park <jill.park@fortressbank.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Mar 2025 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SIG request: KMS/BYOK specifics and artifact delivery

Tessa — quick status update and a couple of technical clarifications.

Status:
- Attached: kms-rotation-report-202412.csv (redacted summary) and hsm-architecture-diagram.pdf (vendor names and datacenter zones). Uploaded to the temp share.
- Drafted BYOK-capabilities.md (short note on limitations for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Created initial sig-kms-control-mapping.xlsx (first pass, marked items that need legal or product sign-off).

Technical clarifications (Jill / FortressBank):
1) Rotation logs: we can provide a summarized CSV of rotation events (key id, rotation timestamp, initiating actor type) — is that sufficient, or do you need raw audit entries?
2) BYOK: for Hosted we provide KMS-derived wrapping keys only; customers cannot import private key material into our multi-tenant hosted KMS. Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS import via Bring-Your-Own-Key (import with envelope-wrapping to our HSM). Private (VPC / on-prem) — customers may retain full key control using HSM or local KMS per deployment agreement. The BYOK-capabilities.md includes exact wording and deployment caveats.
3) HSM attestation: we have vendor-signed attestation PDFs. Monica, please confirm we can include the attestation pages (remove serials) and vendor contact.

Next steps:
- 3/07 afternoon: internal review complete (target met)
- 3/09 10:00 PT: proposed walk-through (we'll send calendar invite)

Jill — if you confirm that summarized rotation CSV is sufficient and the 3/09 slot works, we'll finalize and push to DocuSign on 3/11.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments uploaded to temp share: kms-rotation-report-202412.csv, hsm-architecture-diagram.pdf, sig-kms-control-mapping.xlsx
From: Jill Park <jill.park@fortressbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Mar 2025 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SIG request: KMS/BYOK specifics and artifact delivery

Tessa / Aditya — thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity. The summarized CSV is fine for our reviewers. The 3/09 10:00 PT walk-through works for our team.

A couple of small asks before the call: 
- Please include the sig-kms-control-mapping.xlsx with a short notes column that calls out where procedural compensating controls exist (if any).
- For BYOK statement, can you add a short bullet that explicitly states whether private key export (raw private key bytes) is ever permitted for Dedicated customers? We need a single-sentence phrasing for our procurement team.

We'll pull the artifacts from the secure share and prepare questions for 3/09. Thanks again.

Jill
Senior Information Security Manager
FortressBank
